# IELTS listening score

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/ielts-listening/

Estimate an IELTS Listening practice band from the number of correct answers out of 40. Use the result to follow practice progress.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

A practice mark of 30 out of 40 corresponds to an indicative Listening band of 7.0.

## Limits and checks

Raw-score boundaries vary slightly between test versions. This is a practice estimate, not an official test result.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
